terms.gloss: be lively or vigorous, thrive, flourish
evidence: Cic. ND 2.83: arte nātūrae vīvunt et vigent (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: quae ā terrā stirpibus continentur, arte nātūrae vīvunt et vigent
phrases.english: the things held to the earth by their roots live and thrive by nature’s art

sources: Lewis & Short: vigeo
